faq.q: What is the maximum group size on a Marbella boat rental in 2050?
faq.a: The largest boats in our fleet, such as the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Canados 86, and Ferretti 94, carry up to 12 passengers. That's the legal and safety limit for most charter yachts over 17m. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) have lower caps. Always check the specific boat's capacity before booking.

faq.q: Can I exceed the passenger limit if we are all family?
faq.a: No. Passenger limits are set by the boat's safety certificate and insurance policy, and they are strictly enforced by the Spanish Coast Guard. Overloading invalidates insurance and is dangerous. Even if you're all family, the skipper cannot take more passengers than the official capacity.

faq.q: How many people fit on the Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 (12.5m) has a maximum of 9 passengers. It's a sleek, fast boat ideal for a small group. The price is €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. For larger groups up to 11, consider the Azimut 39.

faq.q: Which Marbella boat rental is best for 12 people?
faq.a: For a full group of 12, choose the Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), or Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús. The Mangusta 80 is a great value at €4,719 for 4 hours, and includes a free jet ski.

faq.q: Are group size limits different for kids and babies?
faq.a: No – infants and children count as passengers. The limit is based on the number of people on board, not age. Life jackets are provided for all sizes. If you have a baby, let us know in advance so we can prepare the correct safety gear.

faq.q: Do the prices change if I have a larger group?
faq.a: No, the price is per boat, not per person. For example, the Astondoa 40 costs €749 for 2 hours regardless of whether you have 2 or 9 passengers. For boats not in Tier A or Tier B, pricing is on request via WhatsApp – just ask for a quote.

faq.q: Can I book two boats for a larger group?
faq.a: Yes, if your group exceeds 12 people, you can book multiple boats. We can arrange for two or more boats to sail together, so you stay close. Contact us via WhatsApp for a multi-boat quote. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so coordination is easy.

faq.q: What happens if we show up with more people than the limit?
faq.a: The skipper will not allow boarding if your group exceeds the boat's capacity. You would need to either reduce your group size or upgrade to a larger boat if one is available. To avoid disappointment, double-check your passenger count when booking.

Planning a group day out on the Costa del Sol? Knowing the exact Marbella boat rental group size limits 2050 is the first step to a smooth charter. Every boat in our fleet has a strict maximum passenger count, set by safety regulations and insurance. Go over the limit and you won't sail – so check the numbers before you book.

Why group size limits matter

Group size limits aren't just a suggestion. They're legally enforced in Spain. Each boat has a safety certificate that states the maximum number of people on board, including crew. Exceeding that limit voids your insurance and puts everyone at risk. The skipper has the right – and duty – to refuse boarding if your group is too large.

What's included in every charter

Regardless of which boat you pick, every rental includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. The 21% Spanish IVA is already in the price – no surprises at the dock. This means you can focus on the sea, not the paperwork.

Best boats for different group sizes

For a small group of up to 5, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are perfect for a quick spin along the coast. For 6-8, try the Speedboat or Bandido. Groups of 9-11 will fit comfortably on the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax). Need space for 12? Go for the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, or Canados 86.

Pricing tiers for 2050 – what to expect

We keep pricing transparent. Tier A (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) is €749 for 2 hours, or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80, including grey variant) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours – and that includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request, so message us on WhatsApp for a tailored quote. No hidden fees, ever.

How to book the right boat for your group

First, count your group – including kids. Then match that number to the capacity table above. If you're between 9 and 11, the Azimut 39 is your best bet. For 12, book early as these yachts are popular in summer. To secure your date, contact us via WhatsApp. We'll confirm availability and send you the booking details.

Local tips for a smooth sail from Puerto Banús

Puerto Banús is the glamorous heart of Marbella – you'll see the superyachts and the Golden Mile behind you. For a longer trip, head east to Cabopino or west to Estepona. If you want to anchor and swim, Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are calm spots. Remember, the skipper knows the best routes – just ask.
